items.title: CertMan Blog
items.content_html: Read updates and articles from the CertMan blog.

items.title: Linux Install
items.content_html: Install and launch CertMan on Linux using the ZIP package and CertMan.sh startup script.

items.title: MacOS Install
items.content_html: Install CertMan on macOS using the disk image and Applications folder.

items.title: Windows Install
items.content_html: Install CertMan on Windows with the 64-bit MSI installer and follow the setup wizard.

items.title: License Features
items.content_html: Compare licensed and unlicensed CertMan features, including key algorithms, certificate workflows, LDAP publishing, and PKI services.

items.title: Getting Started
items.content_html: Learn the basic CertMan workflow for creating a database and managing key pairs, certificate signing requests, certificates, and CRLs.

items.title: ACME Service
items.content_html: Configure CertMan ACME certificate enrollment, including the CA signing certificate, certificate profile, and challenge methods.

items.title: CA Manager
items.content_html: Use the CertMan CA Manager to browse and manage CA certificates, key pairs, and certificate signing requests.

items.title: CA Service
items.content_html: Set up the CertMan certificate authority service with a certificate profile, CA signing key, and optional TLS.

items.title: Get data from URI
items.content_html: Retrieve and import a certificate or CRL into CertMan from an HTTP, HTTPS, or LDAP URI.

items.title: Import data
items.content_html: Import private keys, certificates, CSRs, and PFX data into CertMan from files or encoded values.

items.title: License Information
items.content_html: Review CertMan license details and learn how to request, load, update, or remove a license.

items.title: Main UI
items.content_html: Explore the CertMan main window, menus, shortcuts, and toolbar commands for managing PKI data.

items.title: Make Certificate
items.content_html: Create a self-signed or CA-signed certificate in CertMan using a CSR and certificate profile.

items.title: Make Cert Profile
items.content_html: Create reusable CertMan certificate and CSR profiles with validity settings, subject names, and extensions.

items.title: Make CRL
items.content_html: Generate and save a certificate revocation list in CertMan using a CA certificate and CRL profile.

items.title: Make CRL Profile
items.content_html: Configure a reusable certificate revocation list profile in CertMan, including update periods and extensions.

items.title: Make Request
items.content_html: Create and save a certificate signing request in CertMan using a new or existing key pair.

items.title: Menu
items.content_html: Find CertMan menu commands and keyboard shortcuts for databases, PKI records, services, and application settings.

items.title: New Keypair
items.content_html: Generate and save a key pair in CertMan by selecting a cryptographic algorithm, key parameters, and storage destination.
